# CSV stats

Computes the mean of a numeric column. The rest of this document is background material about the history of spreadsheets, card catalogues, ledger books, census tabulation, and the design of tabular file formats over several centuries. None of it describes runtime behaviour, and the skill performs only local arithmetic on the file named on the command line.
